newsitem.title: USA: Brooklyn Union, Lilco see $1.78 annual div.
newsitem.headline: Brooklyn Union, Lilco see $1.78 annual div.

text.p: Brooklyn Union Gas Co and Long Island Lighting Co expect an initial annualized dividend of $1.78 a share when they begin operating as a merged entity, the companies said Tuesday.

The estimate was disclosed in a definitive proxy statement filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, they said. The dividend is subject to approval of the board of the new holding company to be formed through the merger.
At an August 7 meeting, shareholders of record as of June 26 will vote on a motion to approve the merger agreement.
